title: ErrorResponse
description: Error body returned by fraud-ml-service for every non-2xx response. Contract version 1.0.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. HTTP mapping: VALIDATION_ERROR and UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION 422, MODEL_NOT_READY 503, UNAUTHORIZED 401, INTERNAL_ERROR 500.

message.description: Human-readable summary. Never contains stack traces or internal paths.

request_id.description: Correlation ID (from the X-Request-ID header or generated). Quote this when debugging.

field.description: Dotted path to the offending field, for example context.sender_txn_count_1h.
